title: Dawa.ug
subtitle: Ugandan e-commerce marketplace
description: A buy-and-sell marketplace optimized for Uganda's mobile-first internet. Product listings, real-time messaging between buyers and sellers, wishlists, and safety features for peer-to-peer transactions — built for 3G connections and mid-range Android devices.
problem: Ugandan buyers and sellers lack a dedicated, trustworthy platform for e-commerce. Existing options are either too complex, not localized, or lack proper safety features for peer-to-peer transactions.
role: Built the full marketplace platform including product listing and search, user authentication and profiles, wishlist functionality, real-time messaging system, and the responsive frontend optimized for mobile users.
approach: Next.js with server-side rendering for SEO-critical product pages. Real-time messaging between buyers and sellers. Mobile-first responsive design targeting 3G connections. Safety features including meeting location suggestions and verification systems. Free ad posting as a growth strategy.
hardestDecision: Building trust features — implementing safety tips, secure meeting location suggestions, and verification systems without adding friction that would discourage adoption in a market where simplicity drives usage.
outcome: Live at dawa.ug with product listings, user accounts, real-time messaging, and safety features for the Ugandan marketplace.
whatIdChange: Would integrate mobile money payment escrow, add location-based search for local pickups, and implement a rating/review system for buyer-seller trust.
